General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): long-horizon agents fail mainly through early subplanning errors that propagate path-dependently and through loss of durable constraints; SPIDER value should be expressed as reduced residual novelty plus a re-surfaced verification/constraint layer, measured on trajectory-level diagnostics.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): stable procedures/mechanisms transfer far more reliably than ephemeral site values, so caching the 'how' while re-reading the 'what' is the defensible product thesis; this directs attention to freshness/invalidation economics rather than to universal Web dynamics.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): deterministic accessibility-first locators plus calibrated abstention are becoming commodity, so semantic resolution is likely a supporting capability and market-level moat claims need competitor-strength controls (e.g. native Stagehand-like caching), not four internal arms alone.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a research factory over-produces near-duplicate measurement-invalid packets when an upstream prerequisite (substrate availability, task-bank dynamic range, model endpoint) is unsatisfiable and unaddressed; repair or explicitly park the prerequisite once instead of re-running the ladder.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a single-vantage/single-window measurement is an external-validity trap, but if a second vantage cannot be provisioned the honest output is the exact substrate blocker, not another single-vantage run.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): idle parallel capacity has opportunity cost; an idle lane should be pointed at the highest-value unblocked question rather than left dormant or re-run on a completed thread.

General agent prior (NOT SPIDER evidence): a low completion-token count (~10-15 tokens) with zero answer actions is consistent with an action/observation-space or stopping-signal failure rather than a pure reasoning-capacity ceiling, which is why the representation probe is the cheapest next B3 discriminator.

allocation.rationale: The lane is IDLE after five consecutive audit-PASSed bounded positives on synthetic banks, and its own handoff names the measured-trust-root/probe-adequacy question as the highest remaining product information; the registered C-PARAM-INHERIT next gate (the four-arm benchmark) is dependency-gated on B3 and a new mandate, so it cannot be dispatched here. Decision counterfactual: if provenance can be independently scored and probe-space inadequacy detected, the shipped carrier's certified-safe declaration class can widen safely and a product capability is licensed; if not, the shipped kernel is permanently capped at the closed-world audited boundary and must prefer UNKNOWN over unsafe inheritance - a real, falsifiable product-contract decision either way. Strongest fair baseline: the shipped closed-world guard (B-SHIPPED coverage 0.4667, FA=0) and the frozen-certificate incumbent configuration (FA=9 at coverage 1.0, already bounded-rejected); the decisive boundary already measured is H7 (allowlisted, certificate-admitted declaration whose over-accept lies outside the probe alphabet false-accepts 3/3). Validity and dependency: this is not a re-run of EXP-PRODUCT-38210179652. The mandate requires provenance to be independently MEASURED (not a fiat allowlist) and probe-space reachability to be DETECTED (not assumed), on the byte-identical carrier src/spider/kernel.py sha256 3a6caf970f5c86db19419f7ae57c7125f409eceba922eb2d5a9f5964140bb1b3; the benchmark dependency is carried explicitly. Budget and stopping: smallest decisive batch is one measured-trust-root construction plus one probe-space-adequacy detector against the H7 boundary; if trust cannot be scored without fiat assumptions or probe adequacy cannot be shown reachable, record the irreducible cap as the product contract and do NOT iterate a fourth certificate variant. Opportunity cost: more certification on an already-measured synthetic construction would repeat a measured positive and produce no new product decision, while B3 remains the binding benchmark blocker.
